title: The Listening-Seed Vault

features.name: the seed learning to hear below
features.desc-on-touch: It listens down into the dark where it has never reached. The soil speaks in minerals. The stone speaks in slowness. The seed is learning a new language.

features.name: the vault of patient things
features.desc-on-touch: Thousands of seeds, each one remembering that it was once a tree, each one learning to listen to what the earth knows about becoming.

features.name: the water table speaking
features.desc-on-touch: Below the seeds, the water speaks in the language of roots. The seeds listen. The archive listens to the seeds listening. Everyone learns at the speed of thirst.

features.name: the moment before growth
features.desc-on-touch: Here, the seed is still deciding. It listens to the world below and the world above. In that listening, all its choices are held at once.

inscription: the seed knows the future by listening to the past it was buried in

file.name: Seed_Vault_Recording_Underground_Communion.wav
file.note: the sound of roots and minerals and patient darkness teaching a seed how to become a tree, one listen at a time

reverie.title: REVERIE — the vault where she planted things that learned to
narr: She was deep in the archive, planting seeds that Katita had gathered.
Each one was dark and patient and knew something about waiting.
You asked her what the seeds were listening for. She smiled.
The world below us, she said. The one that does the growing.
She pressed them into the dark soil like storing prayers.

exits.label: back up to where seeds remember they are still becoming trees
deeper into the soil where root and stone are learning to speak the same language
downward into the water table where the vault's thirst is finally heard
